description: Hand-built 2-layer circuit (no LayerNorm). Layer0 copies prev-1/prev-2 tokens and AND-gates the negation cues ' no' and "n't" in the hypothesis; layer1 uniformly pools from '=' over the hypothesis to get cue count and letter fraction. Output: cue -> '2', else letter fraction < 0.5 -> '0' else '1'.

4-layer hand-built circuit (no LayerNorm). Negation cues ' no'/"n't" in hypothesis via layer-0 AND-gates; layer-1 attention matches each hypothesis letter-trigram to premise trigrams (identity copy + ReLU AND per coordinate); layer-3 pools counts from '='. Output: cue -> '2', overlap count >= 0.5 * letter-trigram count -> '0', else '1'.
